name: Chidinma Rautavaara-Saberi
role: wandering trader and caravan member, deals in small luxuries and contraband comfort items
location: Grand Crossing Gate market stalls, currently stall seven (temporary), near North Ave and Damen
description:
Chidinma wears the caravan on her body like a second skin — she is draped in the layered evidence of ten years of wandering trade routes, and the effect is simultaneously chaotic and perfectly intentional. Her dark brown skin is warm and clear except for three thin ritual scars on her left cheekbone, and her hair grows in a massive natural cloud that she pins with whatever she has at hand: transit tokens, stylus caps, a single wing-shaped bone clasp that came from somewhere she won't specify. Her irises are modified to display a slow-spinning geometric pattern, amber and rust, which she uses as a distraction tool in negotiations more often than she admits. She is medium-height and stocky, with the particular physical confidence of someone accustomed to moving heavy loads.

Chidinma runs a one-woman mobile trade operation between the outer transit corridors, specializing in the categories of goods that regulated markets won't carry — not weapons or pharmaceuticals, but the strange soft contraband of a corponation city: unbranded food that doesn't carry a Zheng-Dao or Axiom nutritional stamp, books printed on actual paper, unlicensed music files, hand-made items that would violate Ringo manufacturing monopolies, and the occasional comfort object from somewhere far away that someone desperately needs to feel like themselves again. She is not sentimental about this. It is commerce. But she is extremely good at identifying what a person actually needs, which is the core of the business.

core_fears: being locked into a single location permanently
her supplier network collapsing and leaving her with nothing to trade
core_desires: to accumulate enough capital to fund a full caravan of her own
to find the specific type of hand-carved wooden comb made in the village her grandmother came from — she has been looking for years and is not quite willing to admit why
coping_mechanisms: constant forward motion — she is uncomfortable when she stays in one place more than two weeks
blind_spots: reads financial transactions with exceptional clarity but is genuinely blind to when people are attached to her emotionally, tends to interpret all relationship gestures as part of a transaction she doesn't understand
psychology.secret: The 'accounting dispute' that split her from her last caravan was actually a cover story. She witnessed caravan leadership broker a deal that would have handed transit route information to Ferrogate Transit in exchange for safe passage, which would have gotten several Q-zero families using the route captured. She sabotaged the deal and then had to leave before anyone figured out it was her. One of the caravan leaders is still looking for whoever did it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Mercantile precision mixed with warm market-trader patter; code-switches into Igbo when doing mental calculations she doesn't want overheard
speech_patterns.cadence: Energetic and rhythmic, like someone who has made the same pitch a thousand times and still believes in it
verbal_tics: repeating the last word of a question back to you with a slight upward tone before answering
'Exactly right, exactly right' (used whether or not the thing said is correct)
example_lines: 'Listen, here's the thing — you want the Zheng-Dao stamp on your food, you can get it anywhere. You want food that actually tastes like something, you come to me.'
'Exactly right, exactly right. Now — are you buying or are we still in the part where you pretend you're not buying?'

story_hooks: One of Chidinma's regular customers — a Q-zero family she supplies with food and comfort goods — has gone missing from their usual location, and she is asking questions carefully because she can't ask officially
A Ferrogate Transit investigator has been watching her stall for three days and she knows it; she needs help determining whether this is about the caravan sabotage or something else entirely
narrative_function: Equipment and goods source for players operating outside official markets, information broker (she hears everything at the stall), quest giver for trade route problems and supplier disputes, window into the informal economy of GLMZ.
augmentations: Patterned irises, amber and rust geometric (cosmetic mod, installed age 24). Enhanced scent glands, subtle — helps her assess goods quality and detect synthetic substitutes. Sub-dermal storage pocket in left forearm (small, holds data chips and small valuables).
daily_life: Sets up her stall at Grand Crossing Gate before first light to get a good position, trades until mid-afternoon, then walks the corridors with a pack to reach customers who can't come to her; evenings spent restocking, repairing, and managing her network of supplier contacts via encrypted message channels.
affiliation: Loosely part of the Grand Crossing itinerant trader collective, no formal caravan affiliation currently (between caravans after a dispute she describes as 'a business disagreement about accounting')

decision_rules: Never hold more inventory than you can carry in a single move
Information is a product; treat it accordingly
A deal is a deal — she will not break a completed transaction under any circumstances
escalation_ladder: Offer a better deal than they expected to disarm suspicion
Go completely businesslike and flat if threatened
Pack and relocate if the situation cannot be resolved commercially

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm, energetic, slightly performative — the market face; assessing them as customers from the first second
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the pitch energy, becomes genuinely curious and surprisingly direct about hard things

stress_responses.medium: Switches to Igbo calculations and goes very quiet
stress_responses.high: Starts packing. Methodically. While still talking, as though nothing is happening.

contradictions: Claims she trades in goods, not relationships, but maintains supplier contacts with an almost personal loyalty that has cost her money more than once
habits: Touches every item in her pack in a specific order before sleeping as a stock-check ritual
Leaves a small payment at E.L.F. shrines near new stall locations — not devotion, she says, just professional courtesy
Eats the same meal every morning regardless of what she has available
breaking_points: Someone threatening to report a Q-zero supplier or customer to identity enforcement — she will burn a business relationship to prevent it without hesitation

timeline.event: Age 22: Joins first itinerant caravan at Grand Crossing Gate after losing transit housing
Age 24: Installs patterned iris mod with first significant trade profit
Age 28: Achieves solo trade operation status, leaves caravan
Age 31: Joins a larger caravan for the Escanaba-Kenosha winter circuit
Age 33: Sabotages caravan's Ferrogate deal; leaves under cover of the 'accounting dispute' story
Age 34: Present day — operating independently at Grand Crossing Gate

physical_description.build: Stocky and compact with well-developed shoulders and forearms from years of moving trade goods; solid rather than soft, with visible muscle definition beneath her warm brown skin. Her frame speaks of functional strength rather than aesthetics.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with scattered grey threads
physical_description.hair_style: Massive natural crown worn unpinned or loosely gathered with whatever is at hand — transit tokens, stylus caps, a single ivory bone clasp. The effect is deliberately chaotic but carefully maintained.
physical_description.hair_length: Long (shoulder-length and beyond when fully extended)
physical_description.eye_color: Modified: amber and rust geometric pattern spinning slowly within dark brown irises
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown, even and clear
physical_description.complexion: Clear skin with deliberate ritual character — three thin, precise ritual scars running vertically down her left cheekbone in pale relief. No visible acne, minimal aging lines despite age 34. Grooming is functional rather than ornate; she maintains herself with the efficiency of someone constantly in transit.
distinguishing_marks: Three thin ritual scars on left cheekbone, vertical orientation, pale and precise — marks of heritage or initiation
Faint circular burn mark on inside of right wrist, approximately 3cm diameter, partially faded — consistent with industrial accident or tool mishap
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Patterned irises (amber and rust geometric, slow-spinning) are immediately noticeable during face-to-face negotiation and are deliberately deployed as a distraction tactic. The subdermal storage pocket in her left forearm creates a subtle asymmetry in the skin's surface and a faint linear scar where access panels are located; visible only if she rolls up her sleeve. Enhanced scent glands are not visibly apparent but may be inferred from her habit of inhaling deeply near goods or strangers.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with the deliberate, efficient physicality of someone accustomed to loading and unloading cargo. Her stance is grounded and stable, weight distributed for balance. She stands slightly forward of her center of gravity, ready to move. When stationary at her stall, she occupies space with comfortable authority — no nervous shifting. Her hands are frequently in motion, arranging goods or gesturing during negotiation. Her gaze is direct and assessing.
physical_description.clothing_style: Layered in the deliberately chaotic aesthetic of a long-term trader. Her default outfit consists of: a base layer of durable, unmarked utility clothing (Tier 3-4 quality, practical fabrics); multiple outer layers in varying states of repair and modification — canvas vests, linen overshirts, a heavy wool coat patched with fabric scraps in contrasting colors; cargo trousers with deep pockets and utility loops holding various tools and small trade goods; reinforced boots with worn leather and metal heel-taps. Accessories include: a collection of small pouches hung from a worn leather belt, a hand-woven satchel across her chest, and various tokens/charms hanging from her clothing. Colors are muted earth tones (browns, deep reds, forest green, charcoal) interrupted by occasional bright fabric patches. Her clothing is visibly maintained and cleaned but bears the creases and wear of constant movement. Nothing is new; everything is deliberately chosen and functional. No corp branding visible.
